draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Route Ludhiana to Kanpur
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Route Ludhiana to Kanpur

Dear Vertex Retail Team,

Please be advised that vehicle PB74TA4257 has experienced a breakdown and is being replaced.
A replacement vehicle, registration PB81RI8019, has been dispatched from the Ludhiana hub.
The new vehicle is currently en route to Kanpur with an estimated arrival time of approximately 21.3 hours.
We will continue to monitor the shipment and provide further updates as necessary.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
